name: jump
description: A cartoon jump, played once per event: the game calls instance.trigger('jump', strength); the strength is ignored. It shows a parameter moving inside one sound: the pitch sweeps up by a factor of 3 over the jump, read from a sequence's phase (0 at the jump, 1 at its end) as pow(3, hop.phase). Variation: each jump picks one of four start pitches, 220, 245, 270 or 295 Hz (the sequence's four equal-weight variants, read as hop.choice, as a round-robin would), and a length of 0.22 .. 0.3 s (hop.length). Layering: 0.7 of a sine plus 0.25 of a sawtooth low-passed at 1800 Hz at the same pitch, so it carries on a projector. A 5 ms attack, a hold until 50 ms before the end, a 30 ms decay, cut to zero at the end; then into tanh.
